No suspicious commands, network operations, or obfuscated code are present. All actions are consistent with normal packaging practices for a Go application with bundled assets. The use of `install`, `cp`, `sed`, and here-documents is appropriate and confined to the package directory. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, unauthorized downloads, or execution of external code.
